messages.subject: Re: mathjaxr
messages.body_plain:
Some more follow-up after emails (both individually and jointly) with Joerg
(for ftpmasters), Duncan (for upstream package rgl imposing the
build-depends) and Wolfgang (upstream mathjaxr supplying it).

Everybody is aware of the problem; easiest fix may be to put sources back
into the package along with the minified versions that are installed.

Until then, not using mathjax in rgl is the best way forward.  If
clubSandwich is held back the same way I would consider doing the same there.

Cheers, Dirk

-- 
https://dirk.eddelbuettel.com | @eddelbuettel | edd at debian.org

messages.subject: Two test failures in plotly
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I tried to upgrade the Debian package of plotly but the test
suite has thrown two failures:

-- FAILURE (test-ggplot-sf.R:43:3): geom_sf() geometry collection. -------------
l$data[[4]]$x not equivalent to c(5.5, 7, 7, 6, 5.5, 5.5).
6/6 mismatches (average diff: 1.33)
[1] 7.0 - 5.5 ==  1.5
[2] 6.0 - 7.0 == -1.0
[3] 5.5 - 7.0 == -1.5
[4] 7.0 - 6.0 ==  1.0
[5] 7.0 - 5.5 ==  1.5
[6] 7.0 - 5.5 ==  1.5

-- FAILURE (test-ggplot-sf.R:44:3): geom_sf() geometry collection. -------------
l$data[[4]]$y not equivalent to c(0, 0, -0.5, -0.5, 0, 0).
6/6 mismatches (average diff: 0.5)
[1] -0.5 -  0.0 == -0.5
[2] -0.5 -  0.0 == -0.5
[3]  0.0 - -0.5 ==  0.5
[4]  0.0 - -0.5 ==  0.5
[5] -0.5 -  0.0 == -0.5
[6] -0.5 -  0.0 == -0.5

It seems to check ggplot and I can confirm that ggplot2 is at version
3.3.2 (and thus up to date).

Any idea what might be wrong here?

Kind regards

     Andreas.

-- 
http://fam-tille.de
